historical_programs.sql_template: WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.BUILDING_COMPONENT, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_USAGE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT icte.SPACE_USAGE, COUNT(icte.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Room_Count, AVG(icte.FLOOR) AS Avg_Floor, org_stats.Top_Organization_Name, org_stats.Org_Room_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT icte2.SPACE_USAGE, icte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Top_Organization_Name, COUNT(icte2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS Org_Room_Count, @rank := CASE WHEN @current_usage = icte2.SPACE_USAGE THEN @rank + 1 ELSE 1 END AS `Rank`, @current_usage := icte2.SPACE_USAGE FROM (SELECT SPACE_USAGE, ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM FROM inner_cte) AS icte2 CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank := 0, @current_usage := '') AS vars GROUP BY icte2.SPACE_USAGE, icte2.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY icte2.SPACE_USAGE, Org_Room_Count DESC) AS org_stats ON icte.SPACE_USAGE = org_stats.SPACE_USAGE AND org_stats.`Rank` = 1 GROUP BY icte.SPACE_USAGE, org_stats.Top_Organization_Name, org_stats.Org_Room_Count ORDER BY Room_Count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, fbh.CAMPUS_SECTOR, fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS FROM `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING_HIST` AS fbh ON fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE = fbh.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE WHERE fbh.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 0 AND fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA > 0 AND fbh.BUILDING_TYPE = 'RESIDENT' AND fbh.SITE = 'MIT'), access_level_variance AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY access_level_code_sort, campus_sector_sort) = ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE THEN NULL ELSE ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE END AS access_level_code, ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, campus_sector, num_of_rooms_variance, ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE AS join_access_level_code FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE END AS access_level_code_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE CAMPUS_SECTOR END AS campus_sector, CASE WHEN GROUPING(ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(CAMPUS_SECTOR) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE CAMPUS_SECTOR END AS campus_sector_sort, ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, MAX(ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME) AS ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, VARIANCE(NUM_OF_ROOMS) AS num_of_rooms_variance FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE, CAMPUS_SECTOR WITH ROLLUP) AS tbl ORDER BY access_level_code_sort, campus_sector_sort), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fr.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, fr.AREA FROM `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.ACCESS_LEVEL IN (1, 2) AND fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '36'), floor_area_stats AS (SELECT f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, MAX(i.AREA) - MIN(i.AREA) AS area_range, VARIANCE(i.AREA) AS area_variance, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE AS join_access_level_code FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN `FCLT_FLOOR` AS f ON i.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY = f.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY JOIN `FCLT_BUILDING` AS fb ON fb.BUILDING_NAME_LONG = i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG GROUP BY f.FLOOR, i.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fb.ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE) SELECT alv.access_level_code, alv.ACCESS_LEVEL_NAME, alv.campus_sector, alv.num_of_rooms_variance, fas.FLOOR, fas.BUILDING_NAME_LONG, fas.area_range, fas.area_variance FROM access_level_variance AS alv JOIN floor_area_stats AS fas ON alv.join_access_level_code = fas.join_access_level_code ORDER BY alv.access_level_code, alv.campus_sector, fas.FLOOR

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, SUM(inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_unit_keys FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 0 ORDER BY inner_cte.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.SPACE_USAGE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, su_counts.ROOM_COUNT FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_COUNT FROM `SPACE_UNIT` AS t0 JOIN `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY t0.SPACE_UNIT HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS su_counts ON ic.SPACE_UNIT = su_counts.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT s1.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, s1.total_space_unit_keys, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.SPACE_USAGE, s2.SPACE_UNIT, s2.ROOM_COUNT FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON su.SPACE_UNIT = s2.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY s1.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE, s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s2.BUILDING_ROOM

WITH dept_subjects_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_range, VARIANCE(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS SCD JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS SCD JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE, CCSO.SUBJECT_TITLE, CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS SCD JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN dept_avg_units AS DAU ON SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME = DAU.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS > DAU.avg_units), room_area_above_dept_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.AREA, t1.DEPT_CODE FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPT_CODE, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPT_CODE) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.FLOOR, i.MAJOR_USE_DESC, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_KEY, i.AREA, i.DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPT_CODE = d.DEPT_CODE WHERE i.AREA > d.avg_area) SELECT dsa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsa.SUBJECT_CODE, dsa.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsa.TOTAL_UNITS, raa.BUILDING_ROOM, raa.FLOOR, raa.MAJOR_USE_DESC, raa.ORGANIZATION_NAME, raa.DLC_KEY, raa.AREA FROM dept_subjects_above_avg AS dsa JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso ON dsa.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN room_area_above_dept_avg AS raa ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = raa.BUILDING_ROOM ORDER BY dsa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsa.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, raa.AREA DESC

WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), LargeRooms AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS ROOM, NULL AS SPACE_ID, NULL AS AREA, NULL AS MAJOR_USE, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS min_area_per_major_use, 'OrgLevel5' AS Source FROM OrgLevel5 AS o UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_ID, NULL AS DLC_NAME, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, NULL AS window_column, l.BUILDING_ROOM, l.FLOOR, l.ROOM, l.SPACE_ID, l.AREA, l.MAJOR_USE, l.DESCRIPTION AS MAJOR_USE_DESCRIPTION, l.min_area_per_major_use, 'LargeRooms' AS Source FROM LargeRooms AS l) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, ORGANIZATION_NAME, MAJOR_USE

WITH RoomAreaCategory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, ROOM, SPACE_ID, AREA, MAJOR_USE, DESCRIPTION, min_area_per_major_use, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, CASE WHEN AREA > min_area_per_major_use * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN AREA < min_area_per_major_use * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_ROOM' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS room_size_category FROM inner_cte), MajorUseAvgArea AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM `FCLT_MAJOR_USE` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT DESCRIPTION, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION, FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) SELECT rac.BUILDING_ROOM, rac.FLOOR, rac.ROOM, rac.SPACE_ID, rac.AREA, rac.MAJOR_USE, rac.DESCRIPTION, rac.min_area_per_major_use, rac.room_size_category, mua.avg_area FROM RoomAreaCategory AS rac LEFT JOIN MajorUseAvgArea AS mua ON rac.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = mua.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND rac.DESCRIPTION = mua.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY rac.MAJOR_USE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t0 JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomsFloor2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN `SPACE_UNIT` AS su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 AS r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) SELECT cr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, cr.DESCRIPTION, cr.SPACE_UNIT, cr.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, cr.org_window_column, cr.BUILDING_ROOM, cr.SPACE_USAGE, cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, cr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cr.room_window_column, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM CombinedResults AS cr JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS h ON cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM
